notes.title: Dawn Test Patch Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear Ballers,

We're excited to announce a new update for Superball, bringing several improvements and features based on your feedback. Here's what's new:​

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272741/115ea3304a61d3a3ce15b9129e90e9c67bb4ed45.jpg
New Content
1. Lucky Sign-In and Crazy Summer Party activities added

Winner Challenge Adjustments
1. Refresh interval set to 48 hours
2. Win 5 times to earn all rewards:
Silver × 500
Lucky Card × 1
Lucky Card × 2
Gift–All Types (Epic) × 1

Matchmaking & Spectating
1. Expanded Rank Mode matchmaking range
2. During matchmaking, you can spectate other players’ matches or watch replays (not available in team queues)
3. Added a third gadget slot, bound to Quick Defense

Balance & Quality-of-Life Adjustments
1. Charge-shot hitbox rollback: removed “longer charge increases hitbox size” mechanic
2. Spring Gadget distance reduced from 20 → 15
3. Penalty Area Immunity now prevents stun from Electromagnetic Projectile

Bug Fixes
1. Fixed issue where a team member joining mid-queue prevented the leader from matching
2. Fixed hero voucher not consuming after use
3. Fixed invalid matches appearing in Room List
4. Fixed missing “Forfeit” button in Divine Path mode
5. Fixed issue where Murphy's material was displayed incorrectly in certain scenes
6. Fixed various UI, sound-effect, and system prompt errors

Please refer to the in-game announcements for the exact update time, and plan your schedule accordingly

Don’t forget to add Superball to your Steam wishlist for the latest updates and events. See you on the court!

notes.title: Dawn Test Patch Update Announcement
notes.notes:
We're excited to announce a new update for Superball, bringing several improvements and features based on your feedback. Here's what's new:​
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272741/115ea3304a61d3a3ce15b9129e90e9c67bb4ed45.jpg
🥅 Ranked Mode – AI Removal
In response to player feedback, we've removed AI-controlled players from Ranked matches. This change ensures a more authentic competitive experience. We initially introduced AI to reduce wait times, but we've listened to your concerns and are committed to enhancing the integrity of Ranked play.​

🏟️ Lobby Enhancements
The lobby now displays all ongoing matches

👀Spectator Mode
You can now select any active match from the lobby to watch

🎮 Gameplay & UI Improvements
 Optimized lighting and shadow effects to improve the game's visual appeal.​
 The channel switch button has been changed to the 'Tab' key.​
 Continued improvements to the text filtering system.​

🛠️ Bug Fixes
Resolved an issue where duplicate match entries were appearing in the history.​

🔮 Looking Ahead
We appreciate your participation in the Dawn Test and the valuable feedback you've provided. We're actively working on addressing key areas:


 Match Spectating Feature: To alleviate long waiting times during matchmaking, we are introducing a feature that allows players to spectate ongoing matches or watch replays during the matchmaking process.​
 Charge Shot Range Adjustment: Based on player feedback, we are reverting the increase in charge shot range. Charging will no longer extend the range of the shot.​
 Item Balance Changes: Reduced the distance of the Flash ability, flash can no longer be used inside the penalty area; Goalkeepers will now resist the effects of the Electromagnetic Projectile within the penalty area.​
 Goalkeeper Experience and Matchmaking Improvements: We are working on enhancing the goalkeeper experience and adjusting the difficulty for new players in ranked matches. Efforts to reduce the defensive pressure on goalkeepers are also underway.


📢 Help Us Grow
If you're enjoying Superball, please consider adding it to your Steam wishlist and inviting friends to join the fun. Your support helps us reach more players and continue improving the game.​

Thank you for being part of the Superball community!
The Superball Team

notes.title: What modes will be available after release?
notes.notes:
Champions, we're excited to share more about the content that will be available in Superball's Early Access. Get ready for fast-paced action in our "Dodgeball" mode! Here's how it works:

Rules:

    3v3 battles: Before each match, players will be randomly assigned 3 heroes.
    Knockout: Use your superball, abilities, or items to knock opponents down while dodging their attacks.
    Power-ups only: You can only use items found on the field.
    Shrinking arena and ticking time bomb: The arena gets smaller over time, and a timer on the ball counts down. If time runs out, an explosion knocks nearby players down. Hitting the opposing side resets the timer.
    Three strikes and you're out: The first team to eliminate all opponents wins.

Let us know in the comments what other game modes you'd like to see in Superball!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272741/40913602bf15ff2f30c78f45a5ec32da9b399427.jpg

notes.title: What awaits you after release of Superball?
notes.notes:
Champions, we have prepared a series of materials where we will tell you about the content that awaits you in the early access stage of Superball.

And the first in line is the Ranked Mode!

[olist]
 A 5-minute game, the team with the most goals wins.
 Select a hero of your choice before the match starts. Duplicate heroes are not allowed.
 In case of a draw, an overtime timer begins after the initial one runs out. The first goal brings victory to the team scoring it.
 Your success during the match determines how much XP you earn at the end.
 The first 10 matches of the season are called "Rookie Path": your Ranking Points are doubled and do not decrease in case of defeat.
 There are 7 ranks in total: "Bronze", "Silver", "Gold", "Platinum", "Diamond", "All-Star" and "Legend". Each rank is divided into 3 levels.
 Players can have up to three Relegation Immunities. When a match failure may result in a level drop, Relegation Immunity will be automatically applied. If the player's rank is higher than "Silver", a certain amount of immunity points will be used, however, they can be replenished as a result of the player's winning streaks.
 When forming a team in Ranked Mode, the game automatically selects teams with a similar number of players and amount of Ranking Points.
[/olist]

The higher your rank, the more valuable the rewards for the season. In addition to experience, you can also earn in-game items, currency, and unique titles.

Become a Superball legend!

notes.title: Super Buckyball Tournament Release Date Delayed
notes.notes:
Dear Buckyballers,

Super Buckyball Tournament has been in development for over 5 years, it's been a long journey thus far and we appreciate all the support from the players who've enjoyed the game along the way. 

As the developers, we hope the game succeeds as much as you do. 

After the Steam Next Fest, the team understand that having a free-to-play monetization model with console crossplay would help the game massively on initial launch, which is crucially important for multiplayer games like Super Buckyball Tournament.

To make sure the game lives up to the expectations and has a successful launch campaign, the team has decided to postpone the release date of Super Buckyball Tournament until further notice.

The extra time will allow the team to find partners, further explore the free-to-play model as well as test out the console port and crossplay functionality. 

We hope to share more updates with you all by spring 2023, again, thank you so much for your support and stay tuned on our official channels for more info.

Pathea Games

notes.title: November Dev Update - Hallie Arriving In December!
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow buckyballers!

Hope you all had a wonderful Thanksgiving!

It has finally come to the end of November, which means, time for another developer update!

Over the past month, the dev team has been working very hard on adding more contents into the game and preparing for the upcoming Beta.

It'll still take a bit of time before we can comfortably announce the dates, since we want to make sure all the new contents get checked before it's out.

As the Beta is just around the corner, in this dev update, as well as the days leading up to the test, we'll start to unfold all the major changes coming into December, let's check it out!

Beta Sign Ups

The upcoming Beta will be distributed exclusively via our Steam Playtest channel, and the sign up for the playtest has already opened on our steam page.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272741/fe01f64638f2d9f434dd953b5372353bfda8e4f2.png

If you still haven't signed up yet, be sure to register so you can get notified once the Beta goes live!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1059110?utm_source=ST&utm_Term=Preseason
Hallie Character Intro

Back in September, we revealed Hallie, an upcoming goalie that was designed to compete with Gridiron, R47 and provide more options for defensive players. 

We were unable to share her skillsets with everyone at that time, considering she was still undergoing significant adjustments.

However, as we're quickly approaching the Beta, it's finally about time to showcase what she is capable of!

[previewyoutube=8oJ1MQVFijY;full][/previewyoutube]
Afterimage

Apart from Hallie's character skillset, we'd also like to share a new common skill 'afterimage' that is coming into the game in December.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272741/0812c5b5281b669706967942a984a58730aa5131.gif

Players can select this skill at the start of the match, after activating, it'll start a countdown and leave a ghost tracing the player's starting position. Players can either reactivate it after a few seconds to return to the starting position, or wait until the countdown ends to automatically return to the starting position. During the countdown, players will receive a minor speed boost.

With enough proficiency, you can even block your own ultimate! Although I doubt anyone will actually use that on the pitch :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272741/29df664da5f5999eb43ef432da6666cb71cfc6cb.gif

This common skill should come in very handy, especially for goalkeepers that needed to go attack while still wanting to trackback instantly. 

Besides afterimage, we do have a few more common skills arriving in the next Beta. The idea is to encourage a diverse selection of common skills and provide a more vibrating gameplay experience. 

Steam Deck Gameplay

We were able to get our hands on a Steam Deck last week, thanks to the amazing people at Valve. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272741/c5f0ac14b704dd627409cb570dfd116d13bcae37.jpg

Honestly, Super Buckyball Tournament runs surprisingly smooth on this compact handheld console, feel free to check it out yourself on our Twitter!

So that's pretty much everything for this month's dev update, and I hope to see you again over the next few days!

Make sure you wishlist the game and follow us on social media!

notes.title: September Dev Update
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow buckyballers!

Time for another developer update! 

The developer stream yesterday was a total blast! We showcased plenty of fresh elements, optimizations and of course, a new goalkeeper that is coming to SBT very soon!

In this dev update, we'll give players a rundown of all the major elements discussed during this event, again, feel free to comment and let us know what you think about it :)

Hallie, welcome to the party!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272741/960741143165d9e6152d7ac3196eb5b57d8eb8f1.jpg

A new goalkeeper is finally coming into the game! Covered by futuristic robotic arms, Hallie is a military personnel equipped with the latest tech. As our first-ever female goalie, the addition will add more depth and diversity into the current roster. 

It'll still take us a while to add her into the official game, as Hallie still needs to go through rigorous testing, as well as visual optimizations. More details about her skillset will be revealed at a later date. 

Adjustments on General Abilities

In July update, we've made a big change to the gameplay by removing the item system completely while adding general abilities (GA) that players can select before the match started. Based on the feedback received throughout the testing period, we've decided to continue to adjust the system to make it more strategic and fun to play. 

In the upcoming version, each player will be able to select 2 GA before the match started. 

https://i.imgur.com/RyNRHlc.gif

Meanwhile, we've redesigned the system so that each GA will only have a set amount of usage per match. 

On top of that, the new build we're currently testing on will have a universal cooldown for pretty much all GA. For instance, the rocket fist ability will only have 1 time of usage during a match, with 30 seconds universal cooldowns between each usage. 

https://i.imgur.com/nO61VnP.gif

We're also planning on adding some perks into the game so players can pick up and receive a bonus usage of their GA. Moreover, the GA lineup will also be expanded to make sure a wide range of selections for all players. 

Character Optimizations

You've probably already heard the enlarged stadiums and optimized aiming system, as discussed in the August Developer Update.
https://steamcommunity.com/games/1059110/announcements/detail/2986436715041579613
Along with these changes, the team have decided to revaluate current characters and adjust their abilities to fit with the new aiming mechanic and further optimize gameplay experience.

https://i.imgur.com/fq1ZS8b.gif

This includes skin special effects, ultimate optimizations, balancing changes and more. 
At the moment, only a few characters have been optimized and we can't wait to share more when it's ready later. 

https://i.imgur.com/xZknh8w.gif

Be aware that all the adjustments we mentioned in the developer update are subject to change and we'd love to hear what you think about these potential changes coming into the game in the future. 

Make sure you wishlist the full game and try out the Demo now!

notes.title: August Dev Update
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow buckyballers!

Hope you’re having a great day! 

We've just released the long waited July Beta Top 10 Plays last week, check it out if you haven't already!
[previewyoutube=XTQ1OLpGbCU;full]https://youtu.be/XTQ1OLpGbCU[/previewyoutube]
So it’s been about a month since we last update you with the news of Super Buckyball Tournament, for the past month, the team has been testing out some new stuff, as well as optimizing the gameplay experiences. We'd like to go through some of the changes that are coming to SBT, feel free to let us know what you feel about it in the comment section!

Enlarged Stadiums

Probably the biggest change to the gameplay in August is the increase in the size of the stadium.
We've decided to increase the size of all existing stadiums proportionally, making it 30% larger than the previous ones. To compare, the previous 4v4 stadium is 20% larger than the regular one. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272741/0e41e0a6110efd5a94d01b158ecca45f960616d2.jpg

We've made this change based on several reasons. 

-	Highlights the importance of players positions 
-	Allows for more time & space to organize teamplay
-	Need bigger field to implement mechanics such as grant ball possessions to the side who’ve conceded the goal 
-	Reduce the amount of combat & passes that will get deflected around the wall 

We tried all kinds of sizes and felt like 30% is a perfect balance. The overall game pace will be slightly slower, but not significant enough to spoil the gameplay. 

Players will have a bit more time to hold on to the ball, allowing for more teamplay opportunities.

Positions have never been so important in this new version, since running through the whole map chasing the ball back and forth will be much harder following this adjustment.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272741/daf9ed73ddb9e7f5c8c7e74fd0cd71a010202e32.jpg

Optimized Aiming System

Another part of our work mainly focusing on optimizing the aiming system.

There have been loads of feedbacks (mostly from new players) ever since the Preseason, suggesting to improve the aiming system while adding a crosshair. 

As a result, Dot Crosshair has been added to the game, as well as a mechanic called Shooting Corrections. 

Dot Crosshair

While the crosshair has been finally made into the game, be aware that it functioned a bit differently compared to traditional FPS games.

Of course, you can still use it to help aim the top or bottom corners of the goal, however, since characters in SBT all have it’s own shot accuracy stats, the final shot will likely end up being off-target.
 
Unless you mastered the perfect punch mechanic, which at the moment is only available for R47. The plan is to expand the perfect punch to other characters as well in the later updates.

Demonstration from R47 using controller, with the perfect punch

https://i.imgur.com/vimTrF1.gif

Shooting Corrections

The purpose of add in Shooting Corrections is more for new players and players with controllers, who find it difficult to aim precisely while controlling character & camera at the same time. 

When having the ball, players shoot will be corrected only if the direction where the character is facing is within a reasonable angle with the camera. 

https://i.imgur.com/GsHr2Kp.gif

This change will significantly reduce the learning curve for beginners. while for seasoned players, it’s expected that this change should not effect them at all.

Optimized Camera

The last tweak we've made to SBT this time around is the camera optimizations.

If you rotate the camera in different angles, you'll find that in many times, the camera will move further away from players, offering a wider view angle to observe opponents from behind, as well as providing a better vision for long-range passing in enlarged stadiums.

https://i.imgur.com/Lsu70Hq.gif

Additionally, we've also adjusted the Ball Cam to make the overall transitions smoother, more details on that later.

What’s Next?

While the release date and business model still need to be discussed internally, it’s almost certain that there’ll not be a public open Beta event prior to the Early Access release.

You can still enjoy the Singleplayer version of the game by downloading the Demo on our Steam page, we’re also planning on hosting small-sized closed Beta testing occasionally through our official Discord server, join now if you haven’t already so you can participate when it’s live!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272741/68fd0ed35300450a076154feafee4c23cdd6dd77.png

We plan to release regular dev update every month, as a result of this, the bi-weekly AMA on Discord will be temporarily paused. You can reach out to us through Steam Community, Twitter and Discord. Stay tuned for our next dev log at the end of next month for more exciting updates!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1059110/
SBT Development Team

notes.title: June 2021 Dev Update
notes.notes:
Hey all buckyballers,


The July BETA is almost there!  

While the date for the test is still yet to be announced, we’d like to share some of the latest updates the team is working on recently and the changes to the game that players can expect in the upcoming July. 

New Character

Excited for the new characters? We’ll be able to see 3 new faces joining the game very soon!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458276/58a1f00bae3c07e172e181bd077e31a93d951ab7.jpg

All 3 characters should be revealed later this week so definitely stay tuned if you want to know more about them!

2v2

Here at SBT we’d like to offer players with a variety of experiences, that include new characters, singleplayer and of course more multiplayer game modes. 

Back in February, we introduced 4v4 mode where players get to play in a team of 4 instead of traditional 3 and a lot of feedback have been received ever since. 

This time around we decided to push things even further by adding 2v2 mode into the game. Unlike 4v4, the stadium size in 2v2 still remains the same as the traditional 3v3. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458276/ade62dda67e0ae509c523bfdc5927c5e5c00a028.png

With less people on each team, there’ll be a lot more spaces on the map which players could play to their advantage. 

https://i.ibb.co/5vCtQzd/2v2.gif

At the moment, both 4v4 and 2v2 game modes are still not well optimized therefore minor issues are expected. We’re looking forward to get players to test the 2v2 and provide valuable feedback after the BETA started. 

New Lobby Music

Other than extra game mode, we’ve also updated the lobby with a new set of background music! It has already become one of my favorite music so far so you should definitely check it out!

[previewyoutube=pOjwtdtI69Y;full]https://youtu.be/pOjwtdtI69Y[/previewyoutube]
Selection Screen

In the previous testing, switching characters and swapping positions in SBT can be really complicated and confusing, especially for beginners. That’s certainly gonna change in the July BETA. 

https://i.ibb.co/DRTcmm1/UI.gif

To access the selection screen, simply press the button during pre-match (before the match start), from there players can swap to empty slot or send position swap request to slot that already filled by others. For old players, the temporary slot will still remain in-game. 

Not only you can swap characters and positions in the selection screen, people will also be able to check character abilities and ultimate right in the selection screen. 

We believe adding the selection screen will significantly reduce the learning cost for new players and greatly improve the experiences for everyone participating in the July BETA. 

General Abilities & Removal of Items In-Game

In the upcoming BETA we’ll witness a big change in the gameplay, the items will be removed from the match.

Instead, general abilities are created and players can choose one during the selection screen right before the match started. To balance the system, each general abilities will have different cooldowns times. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458276/d132ee1540046a9e0eb49076f5ac99e247d134d1.png

Out of all the general abilities, some are newly designed but most of them came directly from items. We’ve also decided to move the tackling mechanic into one of the general abilities. 

https://i.ibb.co/J2zJdYG/image.gif

Be aware that this is only a temporary change and we’d like to have players test out during the July BETA. The dev team will decide whether to make it a permanent change after the July BETA. 

For those who liked items and the item mechanic, don’t worry! We’ve saved all the items in our inventory and ready to bring it back at any time. After the game has been released, we’ll likely add an item mode into the game where players can choose to play with or without items at their will. 

Be sure to wishlist the game so you don't miss out when it launches and of course, download the demo later when the BETA is out!

notes.title: Super Buckyball Tournament Development Update
notes.notes:
Hi buckyballers,

Are you excited to play the next BETA soon? We would like to get players informed on the latest news and updates about the game, which we already discussed in the AMA last week.   

Early Access Timeline

We had previously hoped to launch SBT into Early Access this summer, but due to developing reasons, we might have to delay the launch. We are still hoping for a release later this year, and we hope you can understand that we wish to have a more polished game before we dare to release it, as these types of multiplayer games will either make it big or fail completely.

Time for the next BETA?

The time for the next BETA is not yet set in stone, but we’re currently aiming for July. While everyone are waiting for July, we have decided to host 2 Open Weekends, so players can still have fun and enjoy SBT with their friends. The first Open Weekend is scheduled on April 17th and April 18th, during the open weekend we’ll put out the February BETA build for players to play. The second open weekend is scheduled around early June.  

4V4 game mode

After receiving all the feedback from the survey, we’ve decided to keep the 4V4 game mode as what it is for now. The current idea is not to put it into the arcade mode since it offers the same gameplay experiences as the regular 3V3 mode, but we will revisit further after we launch the game, and it becomes more relevant to support a larger player base. 

Protection zone & Tackling mechanic

After receiving all your feedback, we’ll keep then in-game and continue to optimize it. 

The future of the item system

After carefully consider what players have suggested, we decided to make some changes to the item system in the future. We’ll share more details with you guys later.  

Character balance

notes.title: September Update Overview
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

Long time no see! Not sure if anyone noticed that there’s little to no information about the major update last month. That’s because after the July patch we’ve announced that the team needs to take some time to further optimize the game while bringing in new exciting content to the SBT community. As a result, we decided to cancel the August update so that the team can put all the hard works and efforts to make the new version happen as soon as possible. 

Moving on to the September update, to prepare for the big patch that’s coming out later, the September update will mainly be focusing on these aspects: game balance, in-game tutorial, surrender system, new item and more skins for characters.

Let’s start off with game balancing first, ever since the July patch there have been numerous messages from players complaining about how strong R47 is under the current meta. We’re fully aware of the whole situation with R47 and other characters but since game balancing takes time, we decided to fix this issue in the next major update (which is in September) so that the team will not be overloaded by tasks at all times. 

In the September update, players can also expect a brand-new item coming into the game. ‘Reverse Ball’ is a defensive-focused item that can reverse the direction of the ball to the opposite side of where it heads to. It’s an advanced item that has a lot to explore and can be used in conjunction with abilities from other characters to score & defend in the dying moments of the match. 

https://media.giphy.com/media/htdJQAh1quqqsiXD8h/giphy.gif

Another big change coming into September is the in-game tutorials. There have been too many requests about having a proper tutorial system in-game ever since the launch of the open development, and it’s now finally here in September!

The in-game tutorial will allow players to take a few pre-designed practice trials and get a better understanding of the game. 

For old players, we’ve also taken suggestions by adding a practice arena at the end of the tutorial where players can browse items on the field and practice the usage of each item. 

Another new thing we added in-game is the surrender system. As many players have suggested, having a surrender system will help reduces unmeaningful matches. We’re still experimenting with the surrendering mechanics in which it might not be perfect when it first launched but we hope to get better as we go. 

Regarding new skins, we’re planning on having another 2-3 sets of new redeemable skins for each character. Here are some of the previews for the new skins in the next update:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272741/9d8ddedaa3eabae12afdea2427b9a411e7741358.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272741/343827bd49478c9c99008abaf9387697ffd15ace.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272741/526d1fc1a67f6694fdcefe83d5484a4ae5910a40.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272741/04a272d54f8f846ed34c2c29d7334936f46b1318.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272741/2b9e2b23187cd666a3b3ba60b9a606be5b18a551.jpg

Be aware that in the September patch we’ll clean up player coins, while skins that already been bought will still remain in player’s library. So if you happen to have spare coins in your hands, don’t hesitate to spend it right now!

So I think that’s pretty much all the major contents covered in the September update, we fixed & add some of the key things that players have been asking for while saved some time and resources to prepare for more content to deliver in the future. 

A more detailed patch note will be out on the day of the patch where you can expect more optimizations coming into September!

Let us know your thought by talking with us on social media and communities:

Discord
Twitter
Facebook
Instagram

notes.title: July Patch Review
notes.notes:
The July update should be coming in the next few days and here it's a patch preview on what players can expect out of the July patch!

New Character: Eriel

Back in April when we announced the open development of Super Buckyball Tournament, people got very excited about the mysterious blue-haired girl from the trailer. Since then we constantly had players ask us when she would come out, and now the time has finally come!

We have made a little introduction video for her with a nice summer soundtrack to showcase her skills
Check it here：

[previewyoutube=SdfIw2YekH4;full][/previewyoutube]

Her playstyle can vary as she has a broad range of skills which gives her much control across the field. Our recommendation is to play her as a midfielder to help with disables for supporting either the attacker or the goalie.

Her Fish Cannon slowly generates 3 different types of bullets over time, which rotates with each new bullet. These 3 different bullets have different effects when blasting them out to teammates & opponents.

Her bullets are:

Bubble Bullet
Characters who got hit by bubble bullet will be covered in a bubble and stay in the air for a few seconds, they'll not be able to move during the time.

Ink Bullet
Ink bullet will cause an explosion when it hits the ground. If it hits the character, the ink will block the sights of the player's computer screen.

Buff Bullet
Eriel and the teammates who got hit by the bullet will receive a buff and will not be knocked down by any abilities and items.

Her ultimate is called Grappling Hook, which she releases the hook from the mouth of the fish in his hand to grab the nearby ball back to her.

While her speed and agility might not be as fast as Pai or Lang, she does have a very strong set of abilities that can easily shift the balance of the game in the heat of the moment.

Compared to our other characters, Eriel is so far the most difficult character to play and it will take some practice to play her well. Her versatility in the game requires the player to have a broad overview of the playing field and since her abilities are not spamable, timing is very essential for domination.

Skin System

Next after Eriel, the skin system is very likely the most desired feature in this update.

As you have noticed we have had coins in the lobby for a while, but no one has been able to use them yet. 
The good news is that you will finally be able to spend to hard-earned coins.
But the bad news is that we will reset everyone’s coins and levels again. 
This does however not hold you back from starting a new fortune.

We have made simple few skins for each character, including Eriel and we have more coming up.
The skins are divided into components for most characters therefore different skins for the same character can be combined into the look that you like the best.

[previewyoutube=3HGrqBykQo0;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3HGrqBykQo0[/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=wMDXpElhT3c;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wMDXpElhT3c
[/previewyoutube]
Mission System

So what’s more to come in July? Time to introduce our long-awaited in-game mission system! 

The current plan is to have 3 daily and 3 weekly missions in place, by completing it you receive extra coins to get one step closer to your favourite skin！

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272741/12c4ce8bcbe096f3c387b8792863371a9d878e82.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272741/eda24d570e17d54d489e60f4a5e4708ae17ee747.png

Feel free to refresh current missions at any time if you happen to find the mission boring or hard to complete, just be aware that it cost coins every time and you only get 3 chances to refresh per day. 

It’s a quite basic feature by now but we’re hoping to explore more of it in the future, there’ll be exclusive events & activity points system where we giving out a bunch of cool stuff, so stay tuned on our official social media and communities for more!

This Mission system will also be the foundation for a future battle pass, so we would very appreciate feedback on your experiences related to the missions and the system itself as well as suggestions for new missions or for how we can make a cool battle pass later on.

Pre-assigned Position 

We’ll also be making a significant adjustment in the matchmaking process, start from the July patch.
After the update players will have to assign themselves into attacking position (which is position 1 or 2 in-game) or defensive position (position 3) in-game. You may also select both if you’re are fine with playing all positions. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272741/4f4b5683fcfc130d04e44e13eef47777bf9bceac.png

The reason for implementing this is that we got plenty of feedback from players talking about not being able to play the position they desired. Swap position in-game sometimes did not work, either the players on other side do not know how to swap or they both want to play goalie. 

For those who can comfortably fit into any position, this system would not affect them at all, but for players who do care about it, this would improve their gameplay experience by a country mile. 


If you have any good ideas or suggestions, please send you feedback to our discord or sbt@pathea.net 

So that’s all the major things coming out in the July patch, 
We’ll have a much more detailed patch note about the update a bit later, stay tuned have fun in Super Buckyball Tournament!

-	SBT Dev Team

notes.title: June Patch Update Overview
notes.notes:
Hey folks, it’s been almost a month since we came out with the May update, which means the June patch is coming out soon!

So today we’re about to give you guys a glimpse on some of the new features that are going to be available when the new patch arrives, also feel free to tell us what you think!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272741/e114d9a69d081f94b4d12ba002f4a9eddf474010.jpg


For the patch in June, we’re going to add some long-waited features into the game, including a friend system and team system. But first, let’s talk about the adjustments on game modes that are coming in June.

For those who want to play more competitively, we decided to add a new mode called ‘ranked’ into the game. The new leaderboard will reflect those who played in ranked instead of regular matches. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272741/65816b67ca870d7a8aa029895f8f5054a9405bcb.jpg


After the June patch players will be able to see a new mode called ranked and it’ll only be unlocked after players have reached level 7. Be aware that all players data will be reset with the June update, which means even old players will have to reach level 7 (approximate. 5-8 matches) before they are able to play in ranked matches. 


Of course, one of the main issue players might be worried about right away is the lack of players with each individual game mode. We’re totally aware of that and we do believe this is the step we have to make to improve the game in the long run. We’ll also adjust some of the game mode settings to improve the overall experiences for most players. Our team will continue to look closely into players feedbacks while adjusting accordingly. 

Other than the newly added ranked mode, the arrival of the June patch will bring another two long-awaited features: the friend system and the team system.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272741/0439580016de3c7c51c27b49acea4f6dc457807d.jpg


Start with the friend system, just like the friend system in many other games, players will be able to add friends via their username or user ID. Players can then check their friend’s status (if they are online or not) and message them privately. Players could also find others in which they recently played with under the friend system and send friend requests. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272741/0935dc492511184ba70085030e833a1a5fe92e6a.jpg


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272741/0da9b61aac2dc3bf9f9c0dee659b558e57d3a7bc.png


To complement the friend system, we’ll also be adding the team system. The team system allows you to team up with your friends or other players you have recently played with. Each team can have a maximum of 3 players. The team leader can choose to go on regular match or ranked (as for ranked everyone in the team must have reached level 7). 

Compared with other games our friend system and team system are still in the early stages and need a lot of optimizations. We’ll continue to work on these systems and would like our players to provide valuable suggestions on how to make it better. 

Other than these new features, players can also expect a new item in June called ‘swap’. It is easily the most overpowered items in the game, swap allows players to literally switch position with a nearby opponent. A lot of fun new gameplays will come out of this for sure and we would also love to hear back from you how you fell about this item.

https://i.imgur.com/AmSkrtf.gif


Along with the update we also got our new lobby music, compared to the current music this one definitely had more electronic vibe to it. We’d like to take the opportunity of this open development to test out various lobby music tracks to find the best match. 

[previewyoutube=Q4X1bspvnus;full][/previewyoutube]

I think that’s pretty much all for the important new features in June, let us know what you think! A more detailed changelist and bug fix note will be available once the update is ready to launch next week, stay tuned for that! 

If you still haven’t joined our discord, make sure you join now so that you can stay updated with our latest news!

If you don’t happen to have a discord, don’t worry, you may also follow us on Twitter and Facebook!

-	SBT Dev Team

notes.title: May Patch Details - New Character & Stadium!
notes.notes:
May Patch

The May patch is just around the corner and for those of you that haven´t been following us for the past few weeks, here is an update on all the cool things you can expect in a few days.

As you may remember, we announced our newest character Bubba a while back with some information on how we designed him and why we felt the need for such a character.

https://steamcommunity.com/games/1059110/announcements/detail/2233166553097623503

New character:

Since then we have changed his name to Gridiron, and we feel it sounds way cooler.
What do you guys think?

Here is a more detailed description on how to play this character, with his abilities and basic strategies. As mentioned before, this guy was made to be a goalkeeper and he has quite a few skills designed to make him stronger for this position.

His size: Gridiron is a very wide character and he covers a much larger proportion of the goal. Not only is he the widest character, but he is also the tallest, being a couple of centimetres taller than R47.
His Shield is called Line of Scrimmage and it allows Gridiron to use 3 different abilities besides his ultimate.

The first is Plasma Screen which makes him able to cover an even larger portion of the goal.

The second is Shockwave which pushes the ball and other characters away from Gridiron.

The third is Hail Mary which consumes the remaining Ability Points (AP) to create a magnetic field which pulls in the ball and then sends it flying out when released.

These three abilities all use AP which are obtained throughout the game.

Gridiron can get AP in 3 different ways:

1.	Ball hog: Gridiron gains AP when he hits the ball.
2.	Punching Bag: Gridiron gains AP after he body blocks the shot.
3.	Gameday: While not using abilities, Gridiron slowly generates AP overtime.

Garbage Day is the name of Gridirons ultimate. The function is very similar to Hail Mary, but instead of just the ball, it pulls in everything and with a strong force shoots it back out.

An explanation of Gridiron and his skills can be seen in this video

[previewyoutube=2THolD8KCds;full][/previewyoutube]

Dragon Stadium

In this patch our new Dragon Stadium is released. Unlike the Great Harbor Arena, which has a more “underground” feeling to it, the new Dragon Stadium is where the real big games are played.

If you missed out on our previous article which covered how the Dragon Stadium was designed, you can read it here: https://steamcommunity.com/games/1059110/announcements/detail/2216278688533704223
Or if you just really want to see what it looks like, you can check out our Dragon Stadium Trailer here:

[previewyoutube=SkxTrRsC6D4;full][/previewyoutube]

New music

Are you ready to kick back and enjoy these funky vibes for next time you are hanging out in our game lobby? This sweet tune is made by Sean Garavan, a handsome English producer who makes music that will melt your heart.

Check out our lobby music here:

[previewyoutube=Hzxg00POiiI;full][/previewyoutube]

Rocket Fist

How about a new item to bring out more chaos and variety to the game? Rocket fist is perfect for this purpose. Similar to Iron Ball, when you see the lock on symbol on the ball, you can fire of a rocket that punches to ball out of the hands of your opponents.

Here is a short video where you can see how the Rocket Fist works:

[previewyoutube=OpP27IQnhQM;full][/previewyoutube]

Pink Buff

Pink has not been picked that much recently and we have noticed that especially in our more competitive tournaments she is rarely picked. We think it is a shame to leave her on the bench, so we have hired a personal trainer for her, and she is now in tip top shape!

- After many hours on the treadmill, she is now much faster than before. In fact, she is so fast now that she can almost compete with Pai. Of course, only if he doesn’t cheat and use his Light Dash.

- Pinks ultimate has been upgraded as well. Well in fact it is already really strong, so we have just made it a bit smoother than before.

- Pinks right click ability, the Color Cannon has had its animation time shortened. This means that she is now able to shoot it out faster than before.

- And finally, we have increased the charging speed of her color cannon. So she will be able to use it a lot more often than she was able to previously.

So, don’t be shy to pick Pink from now on, she won’t bite. Or will she?

We also have a few extra patches which will be posted out when we update the game.

And don’t forget to join our community on Discord to meet new friends to play with:


Happy gaming!!!

-	The Devs

Patch Note 0.104

Game Optimization
- In quickplay, higher-ranked players within the team will be randomly placed as opposed to the GK position from the previous patch.

Bug Fixes
- Fixed a bug where there is no countdown before the game starts in custom game mode.

notes.title: May Major Patch
notes.notes:
Hi folks,
 
We've been pretty busy since our launch, mostly on fixing bugs and optimizing the gameplay. 
We will keep working on this and appreciate feedback and bug reports from you guys.
But we now have a bit more time on our hands again to resume some of the work we have in our development calendar. 
We're planning on making one major patch every month which will bring new exciting elements to SBT!
Here is a sneak peek into what we are currently working on for the next major patch in May:

- We are almost ready to bring you our new character Bubba!
This masked guy is big, slow, carry a car door as a shield and is a great character for playing goalie. This should give the goalie player another option apart from R47, which is currently the preferred choice for most games.
More details about his skills and stats will be updated before the May patch so stay tuned on our social media!

- Second Map 'The Dragon Stadium' is coming up as well!
We've been working on this stadium for about half a year and are now finally prepared to present it to players!

- New lobby soundtrack
If you didn't notice our last soundtrack, it was probably because we had a loud wind/motor sounding noise that drowned it out. Only recently did we disable it and you're now able to hear our current soundtrack in the game lobby.
But since it is a bit generic, we've been working closely with a great producer recently to make a new and better soundtrack.
 
So that's pretty much the overview of our next major patch, we can't say the exact date of this version yet, but it will be within the next month and we'll update you more details about the patch soon.
 
Have fun playing!

- The Devs

notes.title: Patch Note 0.103
notes.notes:
New features: 

1. Training mode
- We've now added the training mode into the game, players can now click the 'train' button in the lobby to join the game against the AI with no time limit.
- Added a notice for players to join the training mode when they entered the game for the first time

2. Changed some of the server settings and address the issue of 'unable to find server' 

3. Added a feature where players can fill out all AI by clicking 'F2' in the custom game


Bug fixes:

1. Fixed the bug where the effects of R47's right-click ability does not match it's actual range

2. Fixed the shaking camera issue when Lang double jump and then shoots the ball.

3. Optimize the ranking system, fix the issue where high-rank players lose more point when lost the game.

4. Players with higher ranks within the team will more likely be placed in the 3rd position (only in quick play)

5. Cancel the option where players can leave the game when picking characters

6. Fixed the issue where private room with a password will be available to join once players have entered the game

7. Fixed a bug in which players cannot enter the game when connecting 

8. Fixed the issue where the chat bar can't be turned off by pressing 'Enter'

9. Fixed the weird car sound in the lobby
